recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-18325 unless a future renderer reintroduces the 'Mappings for ... Mapping' heading pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-18325 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for Patient requesting that the redundant heading 'Mappings for HL7 v2 Mapping' be changed to 'HL7 v2 Mapping'.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#edf90c3379, and git commit edf90c3379401feb4021332f7611bc0b0bd401f9 removed the MappingsGenerator-added 'Mappings for ' prefix from mapping headings while adjusting mapping-space titles that needed the word 'Mapping' after that generator change.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Patient source declares the v2 mapping as name 'HL7 V2 Mapping' with uri http://hl7.org/v2, and source/mappingSpaces.xml has the shared v2 title 'HL7 V2 Mapping'. The current build renders patient-mappings.html#v2 as 'HL7 V2 Mapping'. A neighboring Jira result, FHIR-18326, concerns the HL7 v2 link rather than this heading text and was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the authoritative current source and rendered build already satisfy the issue. The required commit is an empty audit commit on the combined branch.

related_jiras.note: Same Jira wording search surfaced this neighboring Patient HL7 v2 mapping-link ballot comment, but it requests link maintenance rather than the redundant heading wording and was not decided in this seed reconciliation.
